Source: https://github.com/donmccurdy/glTF-Transform — MIT, v4.5.1 (npm packages core/extensions/functions).
Also used: https://github.com/zeux/meshoptimizer — MIT, v1.3.0.
Pinned npm dependencies install at asset build time; do NOT vendor model weights, compiled binaries, or remote runtime JS.
Build-time structural GLB transforms only; artwork PNG/GIF remains unchanged.
